entry_item.definition: [= badir, badr-a. S. pātra] n. Bowl carried by mendicants to collect alms; offering plate; donation, alms, contribution to charity, collection for charity.

example.definition: To ask for alms, donations, or contributions to charity; to be a religious mendicant.
To ask for alms or donations.
Subscription list (of contributors to charity, etc.).

entry_item.definition: II : бадар бүдэр хорш. спотыкаясь, заплетаясь ногами.

1. auch ~ аяга[н] hist Schale der Bettelmönche zum Sammeln von Almosen 2. übertr Almosen Pl; ~ барих um Almosen bitten 3.: ~ тоншуул Feldspecht m; ~ цэцэг Blüte des breitblättrigen Hülsdorns 4.: ~ хээ[н] Ornament in der Form der Hülsdornblüte
